knownReplayBlockers.issue: The historical-to-final membership format transition is represented and the final migration allowlist is tested for all six function targets, including both admin RPC implementations. A PostgreSQL local apply test must still prove the replacement and resulting constraints.

Static source review found three policy definitions timestamped after the membership rewrite; all three use a direct or indirect active-membership guard, with zero later unguarded policies detected. The DAG sequences all earlier feature policy sources before the rewrite. Runtime PostgreSQL RLS tests are still required.
Verify pgcrypto extension schema and extensions.digest / extensions.gen_random_bytes resolution locally.

pg_cron availability and the expected purge-job definition now have read-only local pre/postflight assertions. A separate loopback-only probe runner is prepared to prove actual scheduler execution using a temporary SELECT 1 job with scoped cleanup. Neither the probe nor the scheduler has been run; this blocker remains until disposable-local runtime evidence exists.
Supabase-managed Auth, Storage, Realtime schemas and roles must be asserted locally before SQL.

The canonical chat-media INSERT policy checks conversation membership but does not bind path segment 2 (the uploader folder in the browser's conversationId/userId/object path) to auth.uid(). A test-only replacement policy adds this ownership check before the membership rewrite. Verify upload, signed-URL read, and cross-user path denial in local RLS tests before considering a production migration.

The direct-conversation RPC source is restored and rollback-only PostgreSQL assertions plus a two-session reversed-pair runner are prepared. Runtime execution is still required in a disposable local Supabase environment to prove unauthenticated/null/self/missing-profile rejection, existing-conversation reuse, exactly-one concurrent creation, exact ACL enforcement, and active-membership gating. Do not enable replay until those runtime tests pass.

The recovered production RPC lacked caller and target eligibility checks. A separate test-only overlay now checks both participants against active membership, verified membership number, final number format, and confirmed Auth email while locking authoritative rows. The overlay and negative-case PostgreSQL assertions are prepared, but runtime validation, concurrency, and exact ACL behavior remain blocked; no production migration is authorized.

Read-only production catalog inspection found postgres-owned public-schema default ACLs granting all table/sequence privileges and function EXECUTE to anon/authenticated. Existing app tables consequently expose non-RLS privileges (including TRUNCATE, REFERENCES, TRIGGER and PostgreSQL 17+ MAINTAIN) and unnecessary direct DML. A loopback-only test overlay and read-only postconditions are prepared; neither has been executed. Production remains unchanged until local CRUD compatibility, RPC grants, and default-ACL behavior pass runtime tests.
